name: apePaymentBadRequestError
description: Standard error payload returned for a rejected payment request.

timestamp.description: The date and time at which the error occurred, in UTC.

status.description: The HTTP status code indicating the type of error.

error.description: A short description of the HTTP status code meaning.

message.description: A detailed message describing the error, including any specific details about the request that led to the error.

path.description: The request path where the error occurred.
